map.connie: AWS is Amazon's cloud: the computers that run much of the internet. Each glowing dot is a Region: a group of AWS buildings full of computers, in one part of the world. Let's build your city in one.
map.note: First steps: about 10 minutes. It's all practice: nothing costs money.
map.advanced: I already know AWS: quick tour
map.tab: 🌍 Your first steps start as soon as you pick a place on the map.
map.storm: AWS reports a problem here. Pick another dot to start.

steps.title: Walk to S3 Lake
steps.body: This is you, Kai, the city's new Mayor. Every building here is one AWS service: a tool you can rent from AWS. First stop: S3 Lake, where files are kept.
steps.running: Kai is walking to S3 Lake…
steps.sally: Hi, I'm Sally! S3 Lake is Amazon S3: AWS's place to keep files, like your photos.

steps.title: Play S3 Fishing
steps.body: Each fish is a file (S3 calls it an object). Hook it, then pick its shelf: hot, warm or cold, by how often it's opened.
steps.sally: Sort my fish onto the right shelves and the lake grows!
steps.grew: S3 Lake grew to {level}! Stars ⭐ are what you've learned, and they grow your buildings.
steps.gained: +{n} ⭐ for S3 Lake. Stars ⭐ are what you've learned, and they grow your buildings.
steps.notyet: Nice fishing! S3 Lake needs {n} more ⭐ to grow. Sally's cards will get it there.

steps.title: Learn 3 of Sally's cards
steps.body: Tap a card to flip it, then say how well you knew it. Didn't know? That's fine: it comes back soon, so it sticks.
steps.strip: First steps 3 of 6 · Learn 3 cards · {k} of 3
steps.terms: Words with a dotted line explain themselves. Tap one.
steps.done: ✓ Step 3 done · Next: Help a citizen

steps.title: Help a citizen
steps.body: People in your city have questions too. Answer this one: it's about a card you just learned, and remembering it now makes it stick.
steps.citizen: Excuse me, Mayor! Can you help?
steps.wrong: Not quite: it's "{answer}". That card will come back soon.

steps.title: Watch Sally work
steps.body: Every building has a helper, called an agent, who does that service's job for you. Ask Sally to store your holiday photos, then watch each step.

steps.title: Say OK to Sally's plan
steps.body: Agents never build anything without your OK. Sally has planned a private bucket for your photos. Look it over, then press Approve & deploy (deploy means build it).
steps.practice: Practice: nothing real is made, and it costs nothing.
steps.strip: First steps 6 of 6 · Say OK to Sally's plan
steps.approved: Built, in practice! Your photos have a private home.
steps.rejected: No problem: nothing was made. You decide, every time.

steps: Finding a bucket for your photos
Photos are opened about once a month: the warm shelf
After 90 days, old photos move to the deep freeze
task.result: Done! Your photos sit on the warm shelf, and old ones move to the deep freeze by themselves.

grad.title: First steps done!
grad.connie: You did it, Mayor. You grew your first building, and you've seen an agent work for you, only with your OK.
learned: S3 keeps your files in buckets.
Shelves (storage classes) keep files you rarely open cheap.
grad.region: Your city is the Oregon Region. AWS writes it us-west-2.

open.jobs: 💼 Jobs: side jobs for the city's businesses
open.decorate: 🌳 Decorate: spend your {n} City Coins on your city
open.ask: 💬 Ask the city: type what you want in plain words

coins.note: You've earned {n} City Coins: spend them in 🌳 Decorate. Stars ⭐ are never spent.

skip.title: Skip the first steps?
skip.body: The whole city opens now. You can play the first steps any time from ⋯.
skip.tourBody: The whole city opens now, with a quick tour instead. You can play the first steps any time from ⋯.

tour.label: Quick tour · {n} of {of}
tour.tried: Sally is on it: watch her in the city, and her steps in the City tab. Practice: nothing real is made.
tour.consoleTry: Try it in the practice console
tour.consoleTried: The practice console opens in a new tab: watch the Console Copilot fill in the form, then press Create bucket yourself. Nothing there touches AWS.

stops.title: Every building is an AWS service
stops.body: Tap one to see what it does, how far it's grown and who works there. Each Region (the 🌍 chip) is its own city.
stops.siteTitle: Every lot is an AWS service
stops.site: Tap {place} to see what it does and who works there. It grows as you learn; each Region (the 🌍 chip) is its own city.

stops.title: Ask in plain words
stops.body: Type what you want, like "Store my holiday photos cheaply", and the right agent walks over and shows you the steps. The demo plays scripted examples; the hosted city does what you type.
stops.hosted: Type what you want, like "Store my holiday photos cheaply". The right agent walks over and does it while you watch.
stops.local: Type what you want, like "Store my holiday photos cheaply". The right agent walks over and does it while you watch.

stops.title: Real changes wait for your OK
stops.body: In the demo, tasks are practice: they show the steps and build nothing. A build in Deploy waits for your Approve. Try one with the practice account: nothing real is made.
stops.hosted: Practice tasks like Try it build nothing. Real changes wait for your OK in Deploy: link your own account with a role you install; every write needs your Approve and your authenticator.
stops.local: Practice tasks like Try it build nothing. Real changes wait for your OK in Deploy: nothing changes in your AWS account until you approve it.

stops.title: Learn, then prove it
stops.body: Cards come back just before you'd forget. Puzzles and the Drawing board check your designs against the Well-Architected Framework.

stops.title: Beside your console
stops.body: Open this panel next to the AWS Console. The Lookout reads the page you're on; the Console Copilot fills in forms and leaves every press that commits to you.
stops.tab: The same helpers work in the browser's {surface}, next to the AWS Console: the Lookout reads the page you're on, and the Console Copilot fills in forms.
stops.demoTab: In the demo, try it from here: the practice console looks like the AWS Console and nothing in it touches AWS. The Console Copilot fills in the form and leaves the press that commits to you.
stops.safari: Safari has no side panel, so the Lookout and the Console Copilot can't sit beside the AWS Console. Ask in plain words here instead.

stops.title: Your account as a map
stops.body: ⋯ → My AWS, live draws your real resources, costs and traffic once an account is linked. ⋯ also has Simple mode and the first steps.
stops.linked: ⋯ → My AWS, live draws your linked account's resources, costs and traffic. ⋯ also has Simple mode and the first steps.

q2.title: The City Brochure Site
q2.intro: Your photos have a home. Now let's put the city's brochure online, fast for visitors everywhere.
